note: Redacted, shape-preserving snapshots of localStorage/sessionStorage captured during storefront-explorer store1 localStorage investigation. Free-text field values and any URL/path pointing to an image asset are redacted to "[REDACTED]"; field names, key names, object/array shape, and non-text identifiers (template ids, Shopify product/variant ids, numeric timestamps) are preserved.

snapshots.label: initial_page_load_before_any_personalization_interaction
snapshots.note: Only Shopify-native storage keys present (sign-in-with-shop cart sync marker, webmcp adapter flag). No teeinblue-prefixed key exists before any personalization interaction.

snapshots.label: immediately_after_clicking_first_template_thumbnail (field 4081, a radio/click interaction)
snapshots.trigger_event: click on template radio input (immediate, no debounce observed)

customization.4081: template-277843 (template field id -> selected template value, enum-like string, not free text)
customization.global-option-847: [REDACTED — value was a library asset path shaped like users/<id>/cliparts/<id>/<hash>_large.webp; treated as URL/asset-path per redaction policy]

entry_shape.timestamp: <number, epoch milliseconds — present, updates on every write>

teeinblue_global_options_shape.type: JSON string encoding an OBJECT keyed by global-option numeric id

example_value_shape.extra: {} (empty object observed; reserved for additional metadata, not populated in this sample)

snapshots.note: Key appears synchronously on click of a clipart/template radio input — no separate save/preview button press required. This auto-selected the default 'skin tone' dependent field (global-option-847) as a side effect of choosing the template.

snapshots.label: same_state_after_1.5s_settle_delay
snapshots.note: Identical to LS-SNAP-02 — no further async mutation observed after settling (no delayed/debounced second write detected within this window).

snapshots.label: text_field_typing_timing_probe (field global-option-849, 'Woman Name', synthetic value typed)

sub_observations.point: immediately_after_full_text_typed (input event fired, field still focused)

snapshots.conclusion: For this text-type personalization field, the localStorage write is triggered on BLUR, not on each keystroke/input event and not immediately on completing typing while still focused. This differs from the template/clipart radio fields (LS-SNAP-02), which persist immediately on click/change.
snapshots.text_field_value_in_localstorage_after_b: [REDACTED — free-text value typed by tester, synthetic/non-real, still redacted per policy]
snapshots.timestamp_behavior: Top-level 'timestamp' in the teeinblue-customizations entry is overwritten (increased) on the blur-triggered write — consistent with a 'last write' timestamp, not a fixed creation timestamp.

snapshots.label: sessionStorage_check_throughout
snapshots.finding: No teeinblue-prefixed key was ever observed in sessionStorage at any point (initial, after template select, after text blur). All sessionStorage keys observed belong to Shopify's own instrumentation (consentHeader, __shopify_agent_context_events, _shs_state, ri-*/wpm-ri-* rotating session identifiers).
snapshots.conclusion: Personalization draft data is stored in localStorage only, not sessionStorage, for this store/theme.

snapshots.label: reload_restore_probe
snapshots.steps: Selected template + typed+blurred Woman Name field -> confirmed teeinblue-customizations populated -> page.reload()
snapshots.localStorage_after_reload: teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options KEYS AND VALUES survive reload unchanged (byte-identical to pre-reload value).

dom_after_reload.note: Personalization form re-renders to its default/collapsed state (only the top-level template selector visible, none of the 3 template thumbnails marked selected; dependent fields incl. the Woman Name text input are not rendered at all, since no template is 'selected' in the fresh DOM render).

snapshots.conclusion: localStorage PERSISTS the draft across reload, but the storefront-buyer-facing personalization FORM DOES NOT READ/RESTORE from it — i.e., save-without-restore. Screenshot evidence: 05a-before-reload.png (state before) vs 05b-after-reload.png (state after, panel reset to unselected 1/2/3 template thumbnails).
